purpose: The words of a recorded choice's verdict, read by the browser's choice account (web/packages/app/src/composition/decision-record.ts) and by the world project's pull request insight (exulanica/world_package/projects/insight.py), so both say the same thing.
rule: A verdict is the first of verdict_order that holds. Its template is filled ({why} is the reason's words, {minute} the minute), then made a sentence: the first letter capitalised and a full stop added unless it ends in '.', '!' or '?'. A no_answer verdict is followed, after a space, by no_answer_untaken when no minute took the request up, otherwise by no_answer_routine. A reason with no words in the society words catalog's decision_reason table reads as reason_unknown; no reason reads as reason_none.
